recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **All-purpose flour**: 280 g
- **Cornstarch**: 19 g *(Note: In the video, Aaron mentions using 18 g or 19 g to soften the AP flour into a bakery-soft cake flour texture)* ([**0:59**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=59s))
- **Dutch-processed cocoa powder**: 13 g ([**2:07**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=127s))
- **Granulated sugar**: 350 g ([**2:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=142s))
- **Baking soda**: 5 g ([**2:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=142s))
- **Baking powder**: 5 g ([**2:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=142s))
- **Sea salt**: 5 mL ([**2:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=169s)) [[1](https://youtu.be/SB7z3sC0X2M#:~:text=These%20amazing%20red%20velvet%20cupcakes%20have%20a,cakes%20a%20festive%20and%20bright%20scarlet%20hue.)]
recipe-section-1.html:
• All-purpose flour: 280 g
  • Cornstarch: 19 g (Note: In the video, Aaron mentions using 18 g or 19 g to soften the AP flour into a bakery-soft cake flour texture) (0:59)
  • Dutch-processed cocoa powder: 13 g (2:07)
  • Granulated sugar: 350 g (2:22)
  • Baking soda: 5 g (2:22)
  • Baking powder: 5 g (2:22)
  • Sea salt: 5 mL (2:49) [1]
recipe-section-1.title: Dry Ingredients

recipe-section-2.markdown:
- **Whole milk (for vinegar mix)**: 120 mL ([**3:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=193s))
- **White distilled vinegar**: 30 g ([**3:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=193s))
- **Flavorless vegetable oil**: 200 mL ([**3:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=193s))
- **Vanilla paste (or extract)**: 10 mL ([**3:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=210s))
- **Large eggs**: 4 ([**3:47**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=227s))
recipe-section-2.html:
• Whole milk (for vinegar mix): 120 mL (3:13)
  • White distilled vinegar: 30 g (3:13)
  • Flavorless vegetable oil: 200 mL (3:13)
  • Vanilla paste (or extract): 10 mL (3:30)
  • Large eggs: 4 (3:47)
recipe-section-2.title: Wet Ingredients & Liquid Additions

recipe-section-3.markdown:
- **Whole milk**: 240 g ([**4:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=259s))
- **Unsalted butter**: 60 g ([**4:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=259s))
- **Red food coloring**: 1 to 2 packets *(Aaron uses gel food coloring available in Austria)* ([**4:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=280s))
recipe-section-3.html:
• Whole milk: 240 g (4:19)
  • Unsalted butter: 60 g (4:19)
  • Red food coloring: 1 to 2 packets (Aaron uses gel food coloring available in Austria) (4:40)
recipe-section-3.title: The Hot Liquid Mixture

recipe-section-5.markdown: - In a large mixing bowl, weigh out 280 g of all-purpose flour, 19 g of cornstarch, 13 g of Dutch-processed cocoa powder, 350 g of granulated sugar, 5 g of baking soda, 5 g of baking powder, and 5 mL of sea salt ([**0:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=52s)). Whisk them briefly by hand ([**0:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=44s)). *You do not need to sift these ingredients, as the hot liquid added later will dissolve any small lumps.* ([**1:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=91s))
recipe-section-5.html: • In a large mixing bowl, weigh out 280 g of all-purpose flour, 19 g of cornstarch, 13 g of Dutch-processed cocoa powder, 350 g of granulated sugar, 5 g of baking soda, 5 g of baking powder, and 5 mL of sea salt (0:52). Whisk them briefly by hand (0:44). You do not need to sift these ingredients, as the hot liquid added later will dissolve any small lumps. (1:31)
recipe-section-5.title: Step 1: Combine the Dry Ingredients

recipe-section-6.markdown: - Pour 120 mL of whole milk mixed with 30 g of white vinegar directly into the dry mixture ([**3:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=193s)). Add 200 mL of flavorless cooking oil, 10 mL of vanilla paste, and 4 large eggs ([**3:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=193s)). Whisk carefully to combine ([**3:47**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=227s)). Because this batter is highly liquid, you do not need to worry heavily about over-mixing ([**3:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=235s)).
recipe-section-6.html: • Pour 120 mL of whole milk mixed with 30 g of white vinegar directly into the dry mixture (3:13). Add 200 mL of flavorless cooking oil, 10 mL of vanilla paste, and 4 large eggs (3:13). Whisk carefully to combine (3:47). Because this batter is highly liquid, you do not need to worry heavily about over-mixing (3:55).
recipe-section-6.title: Step 2: Add the First Round of Wet Ingredients
recipe-section-6.heading_html: Step 2: Add the First Round of Wet Ingredients

recipe-section-7.markdown: - On the stovetop, gently warm 240 g of whole milk along with 60 g of unsalted butter until melted and hot ([**4:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=259s)). This warm liquid addition is an extra step that guarantees the cake crumbs turn out exceptionally tender and moist ([**5:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=305s)).
recipe-section-7.html: • On the stovetop, gently warm 240 g of whole milk along with 60 g of unsalted butter until melted and hot (4:19). This warm liquid addition is an extra step that guarantees the cake crumbs turn out exceptionally tender and moist (5:05).
recipe-section-7.title: Step 3: Heat the Milk and Butter Mixture
recipe-section-7.heading_html: Step 3: Heat the Milk and Butter Mixture

recipe-section-8.markdown: - Squeeze your red food coloring directly into the warm milk and butter mixture before adding it to the cake batter ([**4:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=280s)). Stir it well, adding enough gel until it reaches a deep, vibrant red hue ([**4:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=295s)).
recipe-section-8.html: • Squeeze your red food coloring directly into the warm milk and butter mixture before adding it to the cake batter (4:40). Stir it well, adding enough gel until it reaches a deep, vibrant red hue (4:55).
recipe-section-8.title: Step 4: Color the Hot Liquid

recipe-section-9.markdown: - Pour the colored, warm milk mixture straight into your mixing bowl ([**5:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=305s)). Whisk everything together thoroughly by hand until the batter is smooth, thin, and entirely uniform in its bright red color ([**0:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=44s)).
recipe-section-9.html: • Pour the colored, warm milk mixture straight into your mixing bowl (5:05). Whisk everything together thoroughly by hand until the batter is smooth, thin, and entirely uniform in its bright red color (0:44).
recipe-section-9.title: Step 5: Finish the Batter

recipe-section-10.markdown: - Preheat your oven to 160 °C ([**6:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=386s)). Line a jumbo-sized muffin or cupcake tin with liners ([**6:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=408s)). Using a large batter scoop, add roughly two scoops of batter to each cavity, being careful not to spill over the sides ([**7:00**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=420s)).
recipe-section-10.html: • Preheat your oven to 160 °C (6:26). Line a jumbo-sized muffin or cupcake tin with liners (6:48). Using a large batter scoop, add roughly two scoops of batter to each cavity, being careful not to spill over the sides (7:00).
recipe-section-10.title: Step 6: Scoop into Jumbo Muffin Pans
recipe-section-10.heading_html: Step 6: Scoop into Jumbo Muffin Pans

recipe-section-11.markdown: - Slide the muffin tins into the oven and bake at 160 °C for exactly 20 minutes ([**6:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=386s)). Once a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, remove them and allow them to cool fully before frosting ([**8:03**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SB7z3sC0X2M&t=483s)). [[1](https://youtu.be/SB7z3sC0X2M#:~:text=These%20amazing%20red%20velvet%20cupcakes%20have%20a,cakes%20a%20festive%20and%20bright%20scarlet%20hue.)]
recipe-section-11.html: • Slide the muffin tins into the oven and bake at 160 °C for exactly 20 minutes (6:26). Once a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean, remove them and allow them to cool fully before frosting (8:03). [1]
recipe-section-11.title: Step 7: Bake and Cool

recipe-section-12.markdown:

- **Butter**: 250 g (Slightly chilled, but soft enough to leave a thumbprint) ([**11:59**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=719s))
- **Powdered sugar**: 400 g *(Adjusted down from 600 g for perfect sweetness)* ([**13:21**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=801s))
- **Vanilla paste**: 5 mL ([**12:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=770s))
- **Walnuts**: An extra generous handful (Roughly chopped for topping) ([**17:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VHZq1E4Spnw&t=1032s))
